prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single conceptual editorial artwork for the Linqing Canal Customs cultural topic in Liaocheng, Shandong. This MUST NOT resemble a photograph, tourist-scene reconstruction or accurate drawing of the actual Linqing Customs buildings.
Primary request: an explicitly symbolic original paper-relief illustration about canal commerce and customs paperwork, with NO ARCHITECTURE. Do not invent a generic old gate or hall and imply it is the historic site.
Scene and composition: a quiet abstract indigo canal band curves diagonally through a warm sand-coloured paper field. One simple invented small cargo-boat silhouette with a compact covered bundle glides along this symbolic waterway. Beside the water is a small group of blank folded parchment rectangles, one partially unrolled blank paper, and a few restrained geometric paper blocks that evoke the administration of trade without showing any real document, stamp, script, coin or accounting symbol. The boat and blank-paper group form a clear complete central composition with generous margins. The water is not an actual map or route; the boat is not an archaeological reconstruction. No landscape panorama, named landmark, human, architecture, bridge, pagoda, gate, plaque or geographic labels.
Style and materials: sophisticated flat cut-paper relief and mineral-pigment graphic art, tactile uncoated paper edges, shallow crafted-looking shadows, sparse linework, deep ink indigo, quiet pale blue, mineral gray, muted sand and small russet accents. Distinct river/document concept, not a collage of tourist sights or a realistic scene. Calm editorial clarity and balanced negative space.
Authenticity: this is a non-site-specific AI concept for the historical customs theme. It depicts no real building, terrain, historic customs archive or authentic paperwork. Do not imply exact tax procedures or period-correct vessel design. No seals, inscriptions or diagrams that claim evidence.
Text: none anywhere, especially no writing on the paper.
One single standalone artwork, not a webpage, contact sheet, comparison board or UI. Horizontal 3:2 canvas, ideally 1536 by 1024, native output. Keep every main subject within generous edge margins so it can be shown fully on mobile with contain; do not rely on cropping. No readable text in any language, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, seals, signatures, logo, watermark or identifying label. No real people, portraits, hands, named artist's work or copied museum objects.
